picks.title: Nunes Marques suspende postagens ilegais contra campanha de Lula
picks.excerpt: TSE President Nunes Marques ordered removal of about 20 posts by lawmakers allied with Flávio Bolsonaro that the Lula campaign said contained deepfakes, days before Brazil's Oct 25 runoff.
picks.rationale: A new electoral-court ruling, separate from the 10-19 Meta equal-treatment order: the TSE ordered alleged deepfake posts taken down days before the runoff. The copy must attribute the deepfake claim to the Lula campaign and must not take sides between the candidates.

picks.title: Investment summit: German government strikes AI deal with Nvidia
picks.excerpt: At the 'Invest in Germany' summit in Berlin, the federal government secured an AI partnership with Nvidia and new Amazon investment, part of Europe's sovereign-compute push.
picks.rationale: A concrete government agreement on sovereign AI compute: Germany signed an AI partnership with Nvidia at a federal investment summit. This is a different country and event from the 10-20 Greek Daedalus supercomputer card.

picks.title: FTC to collect public opinion on draft guidelines against 'AI washing'
picks.excerpt: Korea's Fair Trade Commission opened public comment on draft guidelines against ads that exaggerate products' use of AI, so-called AI washing.
picks.rationale: An official regulator action: Korea's FTC released draft guidelines against AI washing and opened them for public comment. They set what anyone marketing an AI product may claim. The copy should call them draft guidelines, not final rules.

picks.title: IOPC investigating officer's use of AI in criminal investigations
picks.excerpt: The UK police watchdog opened a gross-misconduct investigation into a Derbyshire detective alleged to have used AI to make policy decisions, assess risk and justify decisions, and to have entered sensitive case data into it.
picks.rationale: A primary release reporting a new enforcement step: the UK police watchdog opened a gross-misconduct investigation into an officer's use of AI on casework. It sets a public-sector accountability marker for AI use. The copy must say 'alleged', because nothing has been found yet. There is no og_image, so ax-media needs to source an image.

picks.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Nvidia had record lobbying quarters
picks.excerpt: Third-quarter federal lobbying disclosures show OpenAI, Anthropic and Nvidia each set company spending records; Apple also had a record quarter.
picks.rationale: New official filings: Q3 federal lobbying disclosures show record spending by the main AI labs and Nvidia while AI rules are being written. This is lobbying, which is distinct from the 10-14 and 10-16 cards on election and super PAC spending. Report the figures and leave out any judgement on them.

https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/politic.new_action: New TSE ruling (10-21/22): President Nunes Marques ordered removal of ~20 posts alleged by the Lula campaign to contain deepfakes, a separate decision from the 10-19 order on Meta's equal treatment of campaigns.

(6) Euronews on Trump's data-centre 'dividend': a social-media post with no decision, already dropped on 10-22 in its Verge version. POLITICO Europe on coalition fractures over AI liability and Tech Policy Press on Parliament divided on AI: I treated these as ONE story (the same EP plenary debate). I dropped it because a debate is not a decision and it is a running story after the 10-08 POLITICO liability card and the 10-13 von der Leyen card.
